title: AAA shared contract definitions v1
description: Site-agnostic building blocks shared by every AAA v1 contract. Contains no domain vocabulary.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version, semver. A minor bump is additive and backward compatible; a major bump is breaking and gets a new v<N> directory.

id.description: Opaque, non-PII identifier. Profile-declared IDs (page types, facets, playbooks) use this form, never free text.

version.description: Immutable semver version of a reviewed artifact, such as a Site Profile or an evidence entry.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag, for example en-US or fr.

provenance.description: explicit: directly observed from a visitor action or host-declared data. inferred: derived by AAA or an adapter from other observations.

pageRevision.description: Monotonic revision of a page instance. It increments when the page's meaningful content changes without a new page instance (SPA state change). Used for staleness checks.

pageRef.description: Identifies one page instance at one revision. pageType is a profile taxonomy ID.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason, lower snake/dot case, for example consent.withdrawn or evidence.missing.

plainText.description: Plain text only. Consumers must render it as text, never as HTML.

rawSignalKind.description: Raw canonical signal kinds (PRD §3; D4, closed v1 enum).

derivedStateKind.description: Derived states computed by AAA, never emitted as raw signals (PRD §3; D4, closed v1 enum).
